title: VirTra to Demonstrate Next-Generation Drone Defense Marksmanship Training for Corrections at American Correctional Association Winter Conference
summary: Drone incidents at U.S. prisons jumped to 479 in 2024. VirTra will demo simulator-based drone defense marksmanship training for corrections at ACA Feb. 5-8.

**


Pattern Detected


Recent product/conference and customer engagement news often saw modest positive reactions, while management changes and mixed earnings produced more volatile, sometimes contrary moves.


**


Recent Company History


Over the last few months, VirTra has highlighted trade show exposure, customer outreach, financial results, and governance changes. In **October–November 2025** , the company scheduled and then reported Q3 2025 results, showing softer sales and a quarterly loss. Around the same time, directors and executives received or bought stock, and a new advisory board member was appointed. In **January 2026** , VirTra promoted its presence at the **2026 SHOT Show** . Today’s ACA drone-defense training demo fits the pattern of showcasing simulation capabilities to law enforcement and corrections markets.
